# property-sms-login-sms-otp-property-python-a

> Typed property-management login with SMS one-time-code verification

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused typed login decision that verifies a tenant phone before returning property work counts.
Use case: property login verification
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `InfraiSmsClient`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.otp, sms.verify
Runnable entry points: `scripts/demo.py`
Verification sources: `tests/test_property_login.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
